source: Values read from the form tabs and type defense grids of pokemondb.net Pokémon pages on 2026-11-09. Charizard's resistances and immunity were read from the base form's (Fire/Flying) type defense grid on 2026-11-10 ('not very effective' and 'no effect'). Base-form values come from the index. These are the values of the other forms on the same page, which a generated answer must not give in place of the base form's.
